genie_explains_flag.question: Why is EASTTEXAS-05 flagged by rule R-H2S-AUDIT (H2S safety audit)? Show the rule, its glossary definition and the data behind it.
genie_explains_flag.text:
⚠️ H2S HAZARD: This formation has known or potential hydrogen sulfide (H2S) exposure risk. Verify the following before any site entry or well operations: (1) H2S gas monitors are calibrated and active, (2) Emergency Escape Breathing Apparatus (EEBA) is available and accessible to all personnel, (3) All personnel hold current H2S Alive or equivalent certification, (4) A muster point and escape plan are established. Do not rely on this data system for real-time safety decisions — contact your HSE officer.

EASTTEXAS-05 is flagged by **R-H2S-AUDIT** because the rule is **"H2S safety audit overdue"** and the glossary definition says **"Every sour well needs an on-site H2S safety audit ... at least once a year"** with a threshold of **365 days** from the **Company H2S standard**; EASTTEXAS-05 is a sour well with **sour_classified = true** and **h2s_ppm_last_measured = 12000.0**. The supporting data shows **last_safety_audit_date = 2025-10-01**, **days_since_audit = 386**, **well_name = East Texas 05**, **primary_reservoir = Haynesville shale**, and the current **safety_status = critical**, which is consistent with the overdue audit.
genie_explains_flag.sql:
SELECT r.rule_id, r.title, r.severity, r.owner_role, r.action, g.term, g.definition, g.threshold, g.threshold_value, g.owner AS definition_owner, g.source, h.well_id, h.well_name, h.basin, h.primary_reservoir, h.h2s_risk_level, h.sour_classified, h.h2s_ppm_last_measured, h.h2s_measurement_date, h.last_safety_audit_date, DATEDIFF(current_date(), h.last_safety_audit_date) AS days_since_audit, h.ppe_level, h.eeba_required, h.nace_mr0175_required, h.safety_status
FROM oil_pump_monitor_catalog.subsurface_command.engineer_rules r
JOIN oil_pump_monitor_catalog.subsurface_command.business_glossary g ON g.term = r.glossary_term
JOIN oil_pump_monitor_catalog.subsurface_command.well_h2s_profile h ON h.well_id = 'EASTTEXAS-05'
WHERE r.rule_id = 'R-H2S-AUDIT'
